_note: OFFICIAL corporate actions (scripts/corp_actions.json / corp_actions_hist.json) whose ex-day
CLOSE-to-close ratio falls outside the [0.75, 1.30] reconcile window the price builds use, but
whose ex-day OPEN prints at the adjusted basis — i.e. the record is right and the close ratio is
contaminated by a genuine violent move on the same day (DATA_RUNBOOK 87a failure mode 1, 87c's
'the OPEN arbitrates'). Without this the whole split is silently KEPT and the pre-ex history sits
build_sf_data.py now accepts these on a from-scratch rebuild by itself (the open-gate second
chance in its official-factor reconcile). This ledger is the INCREMENTAL leg: the live series is
the release asset + daily appends, and self_heal only reaches ex-dates inside its 28-day window,
so an old mis-baked action can never converge on its own. update_sf_data.apply_ca_arbitrated()
reconciles every entry here on EVERY run, network-free and idempotent.
Idempotence (the apply_manual_rights pattern, no marker needed): the ex-date ratio in the series
is `raw_drop` before adjustment and `raw_drop / factor` after, so the pass only fires while the
current ratio is still closer to the raw drop. Scale-invariant, so a later split re-anchoring the
whole series cannot fool it or double-apply, and a rebuilt bin (already correct) is a no-op.
NEVER add a row whose open gate is not measured — a factor no record and no print supports is a
guess. Sub-Rs0.25 series are EXCLUDED BY CLASS: at 2-decimal storage the heal does not converge
events: 1:5 split, ex 2008-01-21. Ledger factor 0.2 is record-verified (corp_actions_hist, 87 campaign). Live close 2393.99 -> 350.71 = 0.146496, so close-ratio/factor = 0.7325 -> just under the 0.75 reconcile floor -> rejected -> ca_factor(0.1465) snapped to nothing -> split KEPT. Measured live 2026-08-12 on sf_deep parts (rev 4f491f79ce): (a) OPEN GATE — ex-day open 493.50 / prev close 2393.99 = 0.20614, /0.2 = 1.0307, CA-like (<=1.12; crashes >=1.19); (b) TURNOVER STEP — r = t/(c*v) is the cumulative adjustment, and it is FLAT across the boundary (median step 0.9887 vs the 0.20 an applied factor would show), i.e. nothing was divided out; (c) VOLUME — 153,481 -> 1,579,112 shares, the ~1/factor rescale of a 1:5 split. 2008-01-21 was one of the worst single days in Indian market history: -26.8% from the adjusted basis, and F&O members (JINDALSTEL since 2005-04-29) carry no price band, which is why the close ratio lands 27% off the fraction.
